title: Eval4DiRec: A Unified and Systematic Evaluation Framework for Diffusion-based Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.34404v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Leveraging the strong generative capabilities and stable training dynamics of diffusion models, diffusion-based recommender systems (RSs) have recently emerged as a novel recommendation paradigm, attracting increasing attention from both academia and industry. However, despite the rapid growth of diffusion-based RSs, a critical issue has emerged: the lack of a unified and systematic quantitative evaluation benchmark, which often results in irreproducible experimental results and unfair comparisons across studies due to inconsistent data processing, training configurations, inference procedures, and evaluation protocols. To address this challenge, we propose Eval4DiRec, the first unified and open-source evaluation framework specifically designed for diffusion-based RSs. translated_title: Eval4DiRec：面向基于扩散模型的推荐系统的统一且系统的评估框架
translated_abstract: 借助扩散模型强大的生成能力和稳定的训练动态，基于扩散模型的推荐系统（RSs）近来作为一种新型推荐范式兴起，受到学术界和工业界越来越多的关注。然而，尽管基于扩散的推荐系统快速发展，一个关键问题浮现出来：缺乏统一且系统的定量评估基准，这常常导致由于数据处理、训练配置、推理过程和评估协议不一致而造成实验结果不可复现以及各研究之间的不公平比较。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了Eval4DiRec，这是首个专为基于扩散的推荐系统设计的统一开源评估框架。Eval4DiRec支持五种不同推荐场景下的14个代表性基于扩散的推荐系统模型，提供一致且可复现的实验……
tldr: 本文提出了首个专为基于扩散模型的推荐系统设计的统一开源评估框架Eval4DiRec，支持五种推荐场景下的14个代表性模型，解决了实验结果不可复现与研究间不公平比较的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Eval4DiRec, the first unified and open-source evaluation framework specifically designed for diffusion-based recommender systems, supporting 14 representative models across five recommendation scenarios to address irreproducible experimental results and unfair comparisons.
